paragraphs.body: Bradley Beal is ruled out to play against the Sacramento Kings due to a knee injury, according to NBC Sports. He remains unavailable for the upcoming game against the Lakers as well, per NBC Sports. The LA Clippers have indicated that Chris Paul's old jersey number will be assigned to Beal, as reported by ABC30 Fresno.

headline: Bradley Beal ruled out for two games with knee injury; Clippers assign Paul's old number to him
